description: Create a project: where one site or app's feedback lives. Use when the person has none yet (list_workspaces shows 0 projects) or asks for another. Ask what the site or app is called if you do not know. The answer says how they leave their first feedback. The same name again returns the project already made.

name.description: What the site or app is called, e.g. "Acme website".

workspaceId.description: Only needed when you can reach more than one workspace (list_workspaces).
